set firewall family inet filter QOS-POLI.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term EF-CLASS.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

then dscp 34.explanation: Configure firewall filter actions and modify DSCP values.
